gates.name: Existing firmware and golden boot carrier inventory
gates.pass_criteria: Expected ASUS model and BIOS M1603QA.308 are recorded; protected carrier hash matches the approved baseline.

gates.name: Native UEFI screen-reader boot
gates.method: Boot the approved test carrier on physical hardware
gates.pass_criteria: Human confirms audible speech before Windows starts and confirms keyboard navigation is announced.

gates.name: Keyboard navigation and semantic focus
gates.method: Physical keyboard interaction with firmware menus
gates.pass_criteria: Focus, role, label, value and state are announced; disabled controls cannot be activated; password values are never spoken.

gates.name: Windows Setup boot-chain handoff
gates.method: QEMU/OVMF first, physical host only after virtual gate passes
gates.pass_criteria: The expected Windows Setup image loads without claiming Setup is accessible solely because UEFI speech worked.

gates.name: Windows 11 French x64 ISO structure
gates.pass_criteria: EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI, sources/boot.wim and sources/install.wim or sources/install.esd exist.

gates.name: Windows Setup screen-reader speech
gates.pass_criteria: Speech is audible at startup and during language, keyboard, installation, error and recovery navigation; focus and controls are announced.

gates.name: WinPE image inventory and supported accessibility components
gates.method: Read-only inspection of boot.wim indexes, packages, languages and source version; verify against matching Microsoft ADK/WinPE documentation
gates.pass_criteria: A separate working copy is identified; exact WinPE index/build/language and supported speech/accessibility components are recorded; original ISO remains unchanged.
forbidden_actions: Copy unversioned DLLs from installed Windows

gates.name: Windows Setup keyboard-only and speech workflow
gates.method: Boot isolated test image, then separately perform an explicitly approved physical test
gates.pass_criteria: Voice can be activated at the first relevant screen; focus and controls are announced through language, keyboard, setup, error and return paths. VM evidence is not physical audio proof.

gates.name: Windows Recovery Environment accessibility
gates.method: Read-only inventory of actual WinRE image followed by isolated test of supported accessibility path
gates.pass_criteria: Recovery, troubleshooting, advanced options, startup settings and available command prompt can be navigated by keyboard; speech is independently confirmed; recovery/BitLocker secrets are not logged.

gates.name: Installed Windows accessibility
gates.method: Installed OS with NVDA, JAWS and Narrator
gates.pass_criteria: Keyboard workflows and UI Automation semantics are checked with each available screen reader; results are recorded independently.
